Asha (Product): Heads-up: Private/VPC 1.2.1 patch released today to address compliance onboarding gaps (audit export formatting + HSM adapter fixes). Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/private/1.2.1

Tom (Eng): Patch uploaded to artifacts/private/1.2.1 (sha256: e9f7a1). Hotfixes: normalize audit JSON keys and retry on transient HSM timeouts. Includes small installer tweak for air-gapped checksum verification.

Rae (Security): Security note: normalized audit lines improve ingest into SIEMs. Customers using third-party log collectors should re-validate mapping. Also we added a configurable audit-retention header.

Ivy (Solutions): I'll notify active Private pilots and schedule one-off upgrade windows. SEs: please add any blocked customers to the tracker.

Asha (Product): TL;DR: patch live, fixes for audit export + HSM edge cases, air-gap installer tweak. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you need SE assistance.
